sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

rows: [INVENTED_THRESHOLD] gs:I2_051_ShipShape/sh:sparql: The formula check permits deviations within a relative tolerance of 1e-6 or an absolute tolerance of 1e-9 kN, but the authoritative requirement specifies FI = Cf * FIB without any tolerance. This can accept nonconforming FI values. Required change: Remove the undeclared tolerance and report a violation whenever the unit-adjusted decimal FI value is not exactly equal to Cf multiplied by FIB. | [WRONG_APPLICABILITY] gs:I2_051_ShipShape/sh:property[nltl:hasCalculationCase] and gs:I2_051_CalculationCaseShape: Every calculation case linked through the generic hasCalculationCase property is required to have positiveShearForce. The requirement governs positive-shear cases but does not prohibit the same ship from having calculation cases for other shear-force directions, so legitimate non-positive cases would be rejected. Required change: Apply the positive-shear constraints only to qualifying positive-shear calculation cases, for example with a qualified value shape, while allowing other linked calculation cases to exist.

[WRONG_OWNERSHIP] gs:I2_051_ShipShape properties and SPARQL constraint: FI and Cf are each modeled as a single ship-level value, but the requirement defines both along the hull girder as functions of longitudinal position. Multiple calculation cases therefore share one FI and one Cf, making cases in the 0–0.6 LUI and 0.9–1.0 LUI regions require the same Cf to be both 0.0 and 1.0. Required change: Associate FI and Cf with each longitudinal calculation case and enforce FI = Cf × FIB, including the MN-to-kN conversion, independently for every positive-shear case. Resolve locked canonical case-owned terms or paths because the supplied FI and Cf terms are designated ship-owned. | [MISSING_VALUE_BEHAVIOR] gs:I2_051_ShipShape hasCalculationCase constraint and SPARQL WHERE clause: Only one linked case must satisfy gs:I2_051_CalculationCaseShape. Additional cases asserted as positive shear may omit a numeric position, have an invalid position quantity or unit, or otherwise fail that shape; the SPARQL joins then skip missing values and the ship can still conform. Required change: Conditionally require every linked positive-shear calculation case to have exactly one valid metre-valued longitudinal position and to satisfy all operands needed for its calculation, rather than requiring merely one qualified case.
No concrete blocking defect detected in the current candidate.
